tagline: T-shirts made exactly to your measurements
description: A made-to-measure t-shirt e-commerce platform. Customers input body measurements on a web platform. A custom cutting pattern is generated from those measurements. The pattern and materials are sent to a local tailor (Schneider) who produces the shirt on demand.
key_differentiators: Perfect fit via custom cutting patterns generated from body measurements
True made-to-measure — not just size selection, but a generated cutting pattern unique to each customer
On-demand production through a local tailor network
target_audience: Slim and athletic men who struggle with off-the-rack sizing — shirts that are too wide in the torso, too boxy, or simply do not fit their body shape
business_model: D2C e-commerce with distributed local tailor network
